scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there. I'm calling to check on the status of my housing loan application. I submitted it recently.
dialogue.agent: Your housing loan application, ID LOAN-01828, has been originated.

dialogue.user: Okay, and what is the status of my application? Was it approved or denied? Also, could you tell me what my interest rate is and the total cost of the loan?
dialogue.agent: The action taken on your loan application was that the loan was originated. The interest rate offered is 3.490%. The record does not contain information on the total loan costs.

dialogue.user: I see. You mentioned the loan was originated, but you didn't say if it was approved or denied. Can you clarify that for me? Also, why isn't the total loan cost information available?
dialogue.agent: "Loan originated" means your application was approved and the loan is in process or has been finalized. The record does not contain the underwriting rationale for why the total loan costs are not available.

dialogue.user: That's a relief to hear it was approved! I appreciate you clarifying that. Could you tell me my loan term and if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on this loan?
dialogue.agent: Your loan term is 180 months. This loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Great, thank you for that information. One last question: Has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: The purchaser type for your loan is listed as "Not applicable."

dialogue.user: The purchaser type being "Not applicable" means my loan has not been sold to another institution, correct? I'm a bit confused by that phrasing.
dialogue.agent: Yes, that is correct. "Not applicable" in this context means your loan has not been sold to another institution.

dialogue.user: <Satisfied> I'm satisfied with the interaction. The agent was able to answer all my questions clearly, even if some of the information wasn't readily available in the system. I appreciate the clear explanations.
